updatePolicy: Research releases are milestone snapshots, distinct from technical site versions.
Technical releases may fix code, accessibility, editorial wording or presentation without creating a new research release.
A new research release is created when the underlying evidence set or a major derived analysis changes materially.
Historical research releases remain archived and citable once a DOI/archive workflow is activated.
